notes: Single consistent runtime build. The bundled Depth Anything V2 Small Q4 model is models/model_q4.onnx; missing local assets now produce a clear error instead of an automatic remote download. The live input preserves portrait geometry at 224px short side, uses authoritative row-major HxW output readback, and releases per-frame tensors. The service worker is network-first for current assets to avoid mixed-version boot graphs.
